QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Butler's Dilemma
QuestInfo.0: Butler's worried that the soldiers might be getting lax about their duties.
QuestInfo.1: Butler was distressed because the soldiers' discipline has been slipping. He said the rumor spreading among the soldiers about a #eGiant Shadow#n isn't helping things. Go see Williams, an Afinas soldier, to learn more about the rumor.
QuestInfo.2: Williams claimed he was just seeing things and blamed it on lack of sleep, but Chief Kan overheard your conversation and said villagers had seen it too. They call it the #eGiant Shadow#n as well and say it only appears during snowstorms or reddish fogs. Chief Kan is still hoping it's just a fear-induced hallucination.
